subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should the Matrix migration land with the additive `prepareFlow` Plugin SDK hook and generic Gateway restart-admission change in this stack, or should either cross-cutting seam be split for separate ownership?
rationale: The implementation is well-proven and no concrete defect remains, but review cannot determine permanent Plugin SDK and production Gateway ownership policy from tests alone.

options.title: Approve Integrated Landing
options.body: Rebase the stack, authorize the exact dependency graph, and land it together after QA and Gateway owners confirm both generic seams are necessary and acceptable.

options.title: Split Generic Seams
options.body: Move the Plugin SDK and/or Gateway admission changes into separately reviewed PRs while keeping the Matrix catalog migration focused on QA Lab.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Keep this PR open without landing until the compatibility shim lifetime and remaining workflow/package-removal successors are recalibrated.

recommendation.title: Approve Integrated Landing
recommendation.body: Rebase the stack, authorize the exact dependency graph, and land it together after QA and Gateway owners confirm both generic seams are necessary and acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged prerequisite and have the strongest available history for the intended stack boundary, while broader Gateway approval may still be needed.
